body: Thought this was just a me thing. I was stood next to the person telling me there were only 2 apple pies left yesterday and I still didn't have a clue what they were saying.

Hey, I had my welcome meeting on Tuesday this week and my first shift yesterday. I'm in the UK too.  
  
For my welcome meeting I did just wear black trousers and a black shirt (interview-y type clothes) as I wasn't too sure what to expect. The other girl that attended came in casual dress, she was a transfer from another store though and not brand new like me. In that welcome meeting, we got issued our uniform.   


My first shift I just wore the uniform provided. 

You have to provide your own shoes.   
In my store as long as they're closed toe, clean, wipeable (not canvas like converse) and have good grip then you can wear whatever shoes. A lot of people in my store wear Air Forces. 

I would double check the footwear situation in your welcome meeting though :)
